headline: Apple unveils new iPad mini with larger OLED display and A20 chip
summary: Apple announced an updated iPad mini with a larger OLED display, a new A20 processor, and a thinner, lighter design than its predecessor. Pricing starts at $699 for the Wi-Fi-only model, with the device available for preorder and arriving in stores in November.
